a.lede: Despite Nvidia's board saying it has no intention of bringing former CEO Jensen Huang back to the company, some directors are reportedly still pushing for that to happen.
a.title: Nvidia board faction angling for Jensen Huang return as CEO, report claims

b.lede: Amid allegations of multiple affairs, including with a direct report and an alleged Chinese intelligence asset, sources tell WIRED the Nvidia board’s main issue was the former CEO’s “lack of candor.”
b.title: Jensen Huang’s ‘Lying’ Alarmed Nvidia Board Ahead of His Resignation
